note: Final 30 serial actual-JVM accepted cases after audit corrections and named observer module isolation. Node heap deltas include harness/raw/trace/history; one sample, not isolated graph or GPU bytes. Accepted source-bearing trace caches remain local and ignored.

probe.domain: Node semantic seek only; no browser, rendering or GPU measurement
probe.heapScope: Per-case process heap delta retaining raw events, semantic trace, graph, bounded history, source manifest and test harness; not isolated graph bytes
probe.caveat: One ordered-suite sample per case; GC/JIT/cache noise and prior-case retention can affect deltas. Negative deltas are reported unchanged.
